collection.description: A healer has made a powerful plant mixture that may dull pain during surgery but could also stop a patient from breathing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer has made a powerful plant mixture that may dull pain during surgery but could also stop a patient from breathing.

choices.label: Use a small, uncertain dose with consent.
Operate with the safest pain relief already known.
Postpone surgery and investigate the mixture.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient sleeps through part of the procedure but wakes frightened and weak.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient becomes dangerously unresponsive, and the healers abandon the operation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient survives but remembers a difficult ordeal.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient asks the healer to stop before the operation is complete.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer learns that preparations vary greatly in strength.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A safer method of easing pain is found, though it cannot guarantee comfort.
